notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, pools exactly 4x each per-test count, no spares. DMV-style sets testSets(24900, 4): 4 sets + 4 tests = 8 dashboard steps. Book shares 100 Kumar (50%) / 80 Lawrence (40%) / 20 Sinopsis (10%), close to the 2025 paper's 92/84/24 (grile-rezidentiat.ro analysis). passPct 60 approximates the real rule (60% of the national maximum achieved, which was 944 of 950 at Medicine in 2025).
